reasoning_content: Now let me build the APK. First check if Android SDK/Gradle is available:

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check Android SDK
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("which gradle && gradle --version 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo 'No gradle'")
print("Gradle:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("echo $ANDROID_HOME && ls $ANDROID_HOME 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo 'No SDK'")
print("SDK:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
